rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.requirement: ## 24. Safe implementation order

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.requirement: ## 27. Final operating directive
rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.risk: Acceptance unverified outside explicitly tested slices

rows.requirement: **Begin Phase A now and return the audit baseline and remediation plan before any risky implementation or production-impacting action.**
